services.name: our fishing charter company
services.desc: Fishing fun starts at Tidal Pursuits Fishing. Our fishing charter company offers guided fishing trips throughout Nags Head and the Outer Banks, taking you to the best fishing destinations in the Outer Banks. No matter the time of year, we can help you reel in the perfect catch. March Striper Migration - 4 weeks of world class Striped Bass on the Roanoke River in Plymouth, NC Spring fishing - ideal for catching cobia, red drum, Spanish mackerel, flounder speckled trout, striped bass and bluefish Summer fishing - you can reel in red drum, sheeps head, spanish mackerel, flounder or speckled trout in this peak

explain.meaning: A shorter trip, usually about four hours.
A long trip, usually around eight hours.

includes: All tackle, bait, licenses and local knowledge included
blurb: Tidal Pursuits Fishing offers guided fishing charters in the Outer Banks of North Carolina, including inshore and nearshore trips. They specialize in seasonal fishing such as the March Striper Migration on the Roanoke River and target species like cobia, red drum, Spanish mackerel, flounder, speckled trout, and more. Trips accommodate 1-4 anglers with options for half-day, 3/4-day, and full-day excursions.
